recentItems.title: The ‘ceasefire’ lasted two hours Moscow is ABLAZE after  a missile strike on Kyiv
recentItems.description:
The energy truce comes under attack: Trump claims agreements have been reached, while Russia continues to strike Ukrainian infrastructure. Ukraine hits oil refineries in Yaroslavl and Moscow. In focus — new US sanctions, India's reaction, and pressure on buyers of Russian oil. The EU allocates €3.3 billion for drones and missiles, Germany prepares hospitals for a potential conflict, and Poland warns of Russian provocations against NATO. Also in this issue — a strike on a train near the Polish border, fake elections in the occupied territories, a humanitarian disaster in Oleshky, and the new "Carpathian Eight" alliance.

recentItems.title: 3rd Army Corps Breaks the Front Line! Ground Combat Robots Airdropped for the First Time in History
recentItems.description:
A strike on the Moscow Oil Refinery in Kapotnya, the results of Operation Vivaldi, and NATO’s readiness for Russian provocations. In this issue — the consequences of Russian attacks on the Kyiv, Sumy, and Kramatorsk regions, air defense operations, and the situation on the front line. We cover Operation BlackBird, the ATESH sabotage in Taganrog, and strikes on supply lines for Russian troops. Together with political scientist Andriy Rudyk, we discuss the impact of long-range strike capabilities on the Kremlin, the defense of NATO's eastern flank, statements by Fico and Trump, China's role, and the capabilities of the UN.

recentItems.title: ‘Goods destroyed by Russia’ signs: Putin has launched a campaign against Ukraine’s supermarkets
recentItems.description:
Russia is targeting Ukraine's food warehouses, supermarkets, and logistics hubs. Destroyed goods, supply chain disruptions, and rising costs — how are these attacks impacting food prices and availability? In this report, we break down how the Kremlin is trying to exhaust Ukrainians and spark a food crisis. We cover strikes on retail chains, food manufacturing plants, grain infrastructure, and humanitarian aid warehouses. Is Ukraine facing a food shortage? How are businesses restoring supply lines, and how are workers returning to work among the ruins? Featuring eyewitness testimony, expert analysis, and the global implications for food security.
